Damaging a Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Vehicle with a Trace Rifle marks them for 10 seconds. (No, it does not require a matching element)

Only one target can be marked at a time and the mark cannot be transferred to a different target unless the duration runs out. Additional hits to the target refresh the mark duration.

Ally kills on Marked Enemies generate <heavy/>Heavy Ammo for Allies and <special/>Special Ammo for the Wearer.

Spawned Ammo Bricks grant 10.33% of your total reserves (rounded up to the nearest whole number).

<title Refills [G_refill] /> 4% of the Magazine of Trace Rifles from reserves every 0.7 seconds. Works while stowed.

Rapidly scoring 5 Trace Rifle hits on a <link Miniboss, Champion, Boss, or Vehicle [#CombatantClassifications] /> marks them for 10 seconds. Additional hits refresh the mark duration.

Only one target can be marked at a time and the mark cannot be transferred to a different target unless the duration runs out or the enemy is defeated. Multiple people can mark the same target.

Ally kills on Marked Enemies generate <heavy/>Heavy Ammo for Allies and <special/>Special Ammo for the Wearer.

Spawned Ammo Bricks grant 10.33% of your total reserves (rounded up to the nearest whole number).

Ally kills on Marked Enemies generate <heavy/>Heavy Ammo for Allies and <special/>Special Ammo for the Wearer.

Multiple people can mark the same target resulting in each of them receiving the appropriate drops.
